verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own marketing says generated output is "visually editable" and lets you jump between code and canvas, which points to direct editing without prompting. No evidence describes selecting an element and changing its text, style, or layout in place. Copying to the Figma Design canvas and editing raw code are adjacent workarounds, not this capability. Missing for 10: documentation of element selection, direct text/style/layout property editing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can select an element and edit its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt round-trip

citations.quote: Everything you build is code-backed and visually editable, so you can easily jump between code and canvas.
